in_marathi.name: Soundar
in_marathi.long_meaning: Soundar हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। A name derived from the Tamil word 'soundhu' which means 'beauty'. In Hindu mythology, Soundar is the name of a beautiful goddess.
